answer: Honest agents reach the network zenith cheaply, while an attacker spawning thousands of fake identities pays escalating compute and energy per sybil, making mass registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work anchoring: each new agent identity must solve a cryptographic puzzle tied to a unique walnut-seeded nonce before joining. The anchor is the verified work receipt every peer checks. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
